title: On trace invariance and energy-dependent entanglement in muon decay
summary: We revisit a proposed correction to the muon magnetic anomaly measurement and compare it with energy-binned scans reported by the Fermilab $g-2$ collaboration. The central point is that, for a relativistic three-body decay inferred from an ensemble of detected positrons, the relevant neutrino partial trace is defined on the asymptotic state at the detector, not on an idealised state at the decay vertex.
